title: Sicilian orange salad
intro: Sliced oranges with red onion, black olives and good oil: sweet, salty and fresh.

steps.t: Peel the oranges with a sharp knife, removing all the white pith.
Slice them 5 mm thick and lay them on a plate, saving the juice.
Thinly slice the onion and soak it in cold water for 10 minutes to mellow it, then drain.
steps.label: Onion

steps.t: Scatter the onion and olives over the oranges; season with salt, pepper, oregano, oil and the saved juice.
Let it sit for 10 minutes before serving.
steps.label: Rest

tips.t: Add paper-thin sliced fennel or a few smoked herring fillets.
Lovely next to grilled fish or a winter boiled-meat dinner.

title: Panzanella
intro: Stale Tuscan bread, ripe tomatoes, onion and basil: summer with nothing wasted.

steps.t: Cut the bread into chunks and soak in cold water with 1 tbsp vinegar for 10 minutes.
steps.label: Soak

steps.t: Meanwhile, cut the tomatoes into chunks, slice the cucumber and onion thinly, and put them in a big bowl with salt.
Squeeze the bread firmly by hand and crumble it over the vegetables.
Add the torn basil, the oil and the remaining vinegar and toss.
Let it sit for 30 minutes at room temperature so the bread soaks up the juices.
steps.label: Rest

tips.t: Use unsalted bread at least 2 days old; fresh bread turns to mush when soaked.
Add oil-packed tuna or anchovies to make it a summer main.

title: Greek salad
intro: Horiatiki: tomatoes, cucumber, olives and a slab of feta with oregano.

steps.t: Cut the tomatoes into wedges, the cucumber into thick half-moons, and the pepper and onion into thin rings.
Put them in a wide bowl with salt and vinegar and toss gently.
Add the olives and lay the feta on top in one whole slab.
Sprinkle the feta with oregano, pour over plenty of oil and serve with bread to mop up the juices.

tips.t: Salt only the vegetables, never the feta; it's salty enough.
Island style: add capers and a handful of purslane.

title: Tabbouleh
intro: The Lebanese salad where parsley is the star and bulgur just a touch.

steps.t: Rinse the bulgur, cover with the juice of 1 lemon and the water, and let it soften for 20 minutes.
steps.label: Bulgur

steps.t: Meanwhile, wash and dry the parsley and mint very well, then chop finely by hand.
Dice the tomatoes small, keeping their juice, and thinly slice the scallions.
Mix the herbs, tomatoes and scallions with the bulgur; dress with the other lemon's juice, oil and salt.
Serve right away, with lettuce leaves for scooping.

tips.t: The herbs must be bone-dry and chopped by knife; wet or blitzed, they turn to mush.
Part of a Lebanese mezze with hummus and baba ganoush.

title: Oi muchim
intro: Spicy Korean cucumber salad: crunchy, tangy and ready in minutes.

steps.t: Slice the cucumbers into 5 mm rounds, toss with the salt and let them sit for 15 minutes.
steps.label: Cucumbers

steps.t: Pour off the liquid and gently pat the cucumbers dry with paper towels.
Mix the grated garlic, chopped scallion, gochugaru, vinegar, sugar and sesame oil.
Toss the cucumbers in the dressing, sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve cold right away.

tips.t: A perfect banchan with grilled meat, bulgogi or a bowl of rice.
A few drops of fish sauce add depth (but it's no longer vegan).
